post.description: First-party integration only. Requires Authorization: SaaS <session-token>; not a developer JWT endpoint. Checks the unexpired server-side SaaS session.
Existing first-party owned-source Studio generation. Endpoint-specific document schema remains separate work.
First-party voice mode: authenticated bounded recording transcription. Main reasoning provider is unchanged.
First-party voice mode: reads only an owned saved assistant reply and returns configured Gemini or local Meta MMS speech. Meta/MMS mode never falls back to Gemini.

Streams owned saved reply PCM as format/audio/done NDJSON packets. Provider-specific private cache reuse applies; Gemini quota fallback is restricted to Gemini modes. A post-header failure emits an error packet; clients must not treat EOF as success.
Authenticated fixed-sentence voice audition; arbitrary client text is not accepted.

Voice relay ticket for configured Gemini Live or Meta ASR/text plus local MMS mode. One connection per owner, two global, five-minute maximum. WebSocket protocol/setup: docs/meta-mms-voice.md and docs/voice-provider-transition.md.
